 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018  ORAL ORDER
This Criminal Revision Application is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat, today.
Learned APP Shri Hardik Soni appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has produced Withdrawal/Settlement purshis, which is taken on record.

Today, Mr. H. S. Patel, Food Inspector (I.
Card No. 19629) from the Surat Municipal Corporation, Surat is present before the Court and states that as the matter is placed in the Lok Adalat before this Court and if the applicant is ready and willing to deposit the amount of fine, he has no objection, if the matter be disposed of.
In view of the withdrawal / settlement pursis moved by the parties under the signature as well as learned advocate appearing on behalf of the parties.

As such, on going through the record, it is noticed that R/CR.RA/516/2015 ORDER the offence alleged against the original accused-revisionist under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, it is Mansukhbhai Bhimjibhai Hingrajiya vs State Of Gujarat on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12408033/
1 compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

It is pointed out that by virtue of an Order dated 4th September 2015 passed by this Court, pending hearing and final disposal of the present Criminal Revision Application, the execution,
implementation and operation of the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 10.01.2013 passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Municipal Court, Surat in P.F.A. Case No. 42 of 2003, which was confirmed by the learned 12th Adhoc Additional Sessions Judge, Surat vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 27 of 2013 dated 31.08.2015 has been suspended and the applicant/revisionist is ordered to be released on bail.
In view of purshis of the parties, the present Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of.

The applicant/revisionist is hereby directed to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only] before the High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad within a period of four weeks of this Order; as agreed, failing which the Criminal Revision Application shall stand revived automatically.

which was confirmed by the learned 12th Adhoc Additional Sessions Judge, Surat vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 27 of 2013 dated 31.08.2015 stands modified by converting the same into fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only].

R&P; if any, be transmitted back to the trial Court.
